english: choosing to be positive and having a grateful attitude is going to determine how you are going to live your life — a samai symbol
note: Okaikoi spells it Abii Woo Nii Ahe Nu. adinkrasymbols.org records Abii Woo Ni Ahe Nu with a different drawing and a different meaning (keep strong faith in what you ask God for); both readings are kept, each with its source.
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: people who boast about their I.Q. are losers — a samai symbol
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: whatever is begun in anger, ends in shame — a samai symbol (abui: needle)
note: Agrees with adinkrasymbols.org, which reads Abui as a warning against anger.
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: by appreciation we make excellence — a samai symbol
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: signs are always there; we just choose to ignore them — a samai symbol
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: knowledge is of no value unless you put it into practice — a samai symbol
note: This is the symbol in the SpeakGa logo.
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: one has been always sure of success with the right tools and expertise — a samai symbol
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: everyone is important — a samai symbol
note: Agrees with adinkrasymbols.org: respect is due everyone.
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: you climb highest when you help others up — a samai symbol (drawn as a ladder)
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: strategic thinking helps to bridge between where you are and where you want to be — a samai symbol
note: adinkrasymbols.org reads Asrafoi as vigilance and unity of purpose.
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: prevention is better than cure — a samai symbol
note: Okaikoi spells it Atswaa; adinkrasymbols.org spells it Atswa, with the same meaning.
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: that which will save and destroy you at the same time — a samai symbol
note: adinkrasymbols.org reads Asamankama as: be cautious of the company you keep.
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: no one is useless in this world — a samai symbol
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: true progress is slow but sure — a samai symbol
image_credit: Symbol as drawn by Okaikoi (okaikoi.com), shown without their card design

english: Okaikoi, a Ghanaian fashion and design label, documents 17 Ga samai symbols in its Ga Samai Meanings article (2022). It describes the Ga samai as focused on understanding individual experience, and notes that many may have been lost over the years.
note: Resource record: points readers to the Okaikoi article.
